title: •You Want This, Don’t You?
caption: •You Want This, Don’t You? (V)
game_text: If opponent just drew a card for destiny, deploy on table and stack that card face up here. Opponent may lose 3 Force to take card stacked here into hand; place this card in Used Pile. {control}
lore: “I can feel the hate swelling in you now...”

notes: Unique. Printed base is an Effect; slip banner IMMEDIATE EFFECT with NO grabber box at the banner's right end → grabber false. Curly apostrophe in the slip's title (Don’t). Trailing red circle-slash C → {control} (stub 'Immune to Control'). Margin credits (one line each): left 'Original concept by Reid Smith', right 'Origins US Nationals 2005'. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes (wiki straight single). Base scan only 350 px; Tatooine copyright by set convention (2001 form), not legible. Modern: VB3 only (-pre, 350 px). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
